Disaster Recovery

Backup, replication and tested recovery plans using Veeam, Acronis and Quorum onQ.

How we deliver it

We define how much data you can lose (RPO) and how fast you must be back (RTO), then match the tooling to it. Recovery is tested on a schedule, so the plan is proven before you need it.

  1. Business impact analysis: rank systems by RTO and RPO
  2. Design: 3-2-1 backups with an immutable or offline copy
  3. Implement: backup jobs, replication and runbooks
  4. Test: scheduled restore and failover drills with reports

Outcomes

  • Defined recovery targets
  • Ransomware-resistant backups
  • Evidence of successful recovery tests
